original_question: What is the chromosomal location of the gene associated with combined malonic and methylmalonic aciduria (CMAMMA)?

final_qi.question: What is the chromosomal location of the gene associated with combined malonic and methylmalonic aciduria (CMAMMA)?
final_qi.long_answer: Combined malonic and methylmalonic aciduria (CMAMMA) is caused by pathogenic variants in the ACSF3 gene (acyl-CoA synthetase family member 3). Cytogenetic mapping places ACSF3 on the long arm of chromosome 16 at band q24.3, so the chromosomal location associated with CMAMMA is 16q24.3.
